title: Lemma 3.5: one positive rank-one update simultaneously compatible with both moving spectral barriers
statement_scope: Whole lemma 'Both Barriers': if A is symmetric with lmax(A)<u, lmin(A)>l, Phi^u(A)≤epsU, Phi_l(A)≤epsL, and 0≤1/δU+epsU≤1/δL−epsL, then there exists an index i and a positive t such that L_A(v_i)≥1/t≥U_A(v_i), lmax(A+t v_i v_i^T)<u+δU, and lmin(A+t v_i v_i^T)>l+δL. All hypotheses, parameters and the bothcond inequality are retained unchanged.
